Hello world! I am a public official who unexpectedly got into R package development during my senior year studying Statistics. 

Since then, my work has focused on fixing the limitations of traditional spatial models when applied to archipelagos, especially in my home country of the Philippines. You can find my core spatial tools published on [CRAN.](https://www.r-pkg.org/maint/ninotalingting77@gmail.com)

When I am not working in public administration, I've architected and maintain [PinasR](https://pinasr.r-universe.dev/packages), a centralized registry for open-source packages created by Filipino R developers, built to make reproducible research accessible to all.
